mapper.select: SELECT * FROM one_off_appointments WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM one_off_appointments WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM one_off_appointments WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='pending' ORDER BY due_at_utc ASC LIMIT 50
SELECT * FROM one_off_appointments WHERE status='pending' AND due_at_utc <= #{now} ORDER BY due_at_utc ASC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE one_off_appointments SET status='delivered', delivered_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='pending'
UPDATE one_off_appointments SET status='canceled' WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='pending'
UPDATE one_off_appointments SET status='deleted', title='来源对话已删除' WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND source_conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND status <> 'deleted'

UPDATE inbox_items SET body='来源对话已删除', state='dismissed' WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND source_kind='one_off_appointment' AND source_id IN (SELECT id FROM one_off_appointments WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND source_conversation_id=#{conversationId})
